channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Amid PM Modi's praise for Kannada pride, BJP calls out Congress high command 'culture' in Karnataka
item.description: "First, it was Rajiv Gandhi who publicly humiliated the towering Karnataka leader Shri Veerendra Patil. Now, decades later, the pattern repeats, with AICC General Secretary K C Venugopal lecturing Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and Deputy Chief Minister D K Shivakumar on how to run the state," Malviya said.

item.title: From Op Sindoor to Ram Temple flag hoisting: PM Modi says 2025 gave India 'greater self-confidence'
item.description: Addressing his monthly radio programme 'Mann Ki Baat', PM Modi said, "In just a few days, the year 2026 will knock on our door soon, and today, as I speak to you, memories of the entire year are swirling in my mind. Many images, discussions and achievements that united the nation. 2025 gave us many such moments that have made every Indian proud."

item.title: Under house arrest, say ex-CM Mehbooba Mufti, NC MP Mehdi ahead of protest over reservation policy
item.description: Iltija Mufti, PDP leader and daughter of Mehbooba Mufti, said on X on Sunday, "Like many others Ive also been placed under house arrest at Srinagar today. The insecurity & paranoia of the security agencies knows no bounds. This is the 'normalcy' in Naya Kashmir. An entire contingent of female police personnel is deputed at the gate to physically stop me. Care to explain under what grounds @JmuKmrPolice?".

item.title: IMF ignores its own report to okay $1.29 bn loan for Pakistan
item.description: "The timing is striking: the diagnostic was published just before the Board meeting that approved the latest disbursement. In effect, the IMF has acknowledged that Pakistan's governance vulnerabilities are systemic, yet continues to lend without dismantling the ecosystem of capture that perpetuates the crisis," according to an article by Dr Sakariya Kareem in the UK-based Asian Lite newspaper.

item.title: Total investment in real estate at $3.5 billion in 2025: Report
item.description: As per the report titled 'Trends in Private Equity Investments in India: H2 2025', office assets continued to dominate private equity inflows during the year. Office real estate attracted 58 per cent of the total investments, amounting to $2 billion, reflecting strong investor confidence in the sector's scale, rental stability and institutional demand.

item.title: Nothing to learn from RSS, it is an "organisation of hatred", says Cong MP Manickam Tagore
item.description: Drawing a sharp comparison, the Congress MP added, "In the way al-Qaeda operates through bloodshed, the RSS too does the same work inside the country—spreading hatred." Tagore went on to underline the Congress party's mass connect, saying, "Congress is a people's party, a grounded party. From village to village, people are connected with our party. Congress does not need to learn anything from the RSS."

item.title: Kartik Aaryan–Ananya Panday's Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri screened at Rashtrapati Bhavan; netizens wonder why
item.description: Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday's romantic comedy Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri has received a prestigious screening at Rashtrapati Bhavan. While the makers view the honour as recognition of the film's progressive theme and social messaging, the announcement has not gone down well with netizens, who have questioned the merit of the screening. The film has also not performed well at the box office.

item.title: Silver surge past Apple, Alphabet; eyes NVIDIA as world's second-most valuable asset
item.description: Gold continues to remain far ahead as the world's most valued asset, with a market capitalisation of $31.598 trillion as of Friday (December 26). The sharp rise in silver's valuation comes amid a historic rally in prices. Spot silver on Comex crossed the $75 per ounce mark on Friday and extended gains to hit a fresh record high.

item.title: Messi event chaos: Organiser Satadru Dutta sent to judicial custody till Jan 9
item.description: Dutta, who was arrested by Bidhannagar Police after pandemonium broke out at Yuva Bharati Krirangan in Salt Lake during the event, was presented before the court after the completion of his 14-day police custody.

item.title: NSI 2025: Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla's 51-Case Series Signals India's Entry into Parafascicular Intraventricular Tumor Surgery
item.description: Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla is a senior neurosurgeon based in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, and the Founder–Chairman and Managing Director of Dr. Rao's Hospital
